title: Persistent live TV while browsing
notes: A live channel now keeps playing in a focusable mini-player while you browse Movies, Shows, Add-ons, Search, Settings and other OpenTV screens. Selecting the mini-player returns to full screen; its close button stops live TV. The same player and decoder move between full-screen and mini-player modes, and live TV stops before on-demand playback so decoder load is never doubled. Existing channels, guide, favourites, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved.
